title: DO NOT MISS THIS TOUR.  You will not be disappointed.
text: This was our first tour when we arrived in Barcelona from the states. We were tired and thought perhaps it was too much for the same day  after many hours in flight BUT once you get there you can just see the magic of this house.  The lights, the rooms, the history.  We arrived earlier than our allotted schedule time and they let us change our time so we did not have to wait.  All was amazing.  Do yourself a favor and do the tablet audio tour.  It's not only audio but you can visually see things that you most likely would not see or understand - For example the turtles.  You'll see what I mean
author: Melba_M

title: Excellent Self Guided Tour
text: This is an easy self guided tour to do on your own.  How can you visit Barcelona and not visit this iconic house?
author: Tracey_Q

title: Casa Batlló is beautiful...
text: Casa Batlló is beautiful and well worth a visit. The architecture and details are incredible, and the audio tour offers interesting insights into Gaudí’s vision, although it could have been shorter and less detailed.
author: Nancy_T

title: Easy access to the brilliant home
text: Easy ticketing and planning.   This house is a highlight and delightful sensory experience.  The guided tour was great and we really enjoyed the experience.
author: 2Pippin2

title: Guadi does not disappoint
text: A must see in Madrid. The Gaudi house is stunning. The architecture is amazing, like something out of a fantasy novel. The audio tour was so informative as well.
author: J3291NVluisc

title: Casa Batllo
text: Perfect with the audio guide. Such an exquisite place to visit right in the heart of a bustling Barcelona
author: Joanne_S

title: Must visit for Barcelona
text: We bought the Gold experience - and were surprised at home much we loved the interactive tablets and access to the roof, living quarters, and the concierge office. This was our second favourite attraction in Barcelona. The building was breath taking. Because of our ticket we walked straight in and there was no queue which was amazing.
author: K6571ADcharlottev

title: House of dreams
text: It was great to have the opportunity to see one of the great works of "Gaudi" which showed how nature was his source of inspiration and imagination. We loved the audio explanation and the experience of "Gaudi dreams"
author: Hind_M

title: Platinum Package is a must
text: I cannot recommend the platinum package enough. You get to skip all the lines, you get an iPad type device that is so fun to watch as you go through the rooms. The iPad shows you what it once looked like as well as fun tips about why it’s designed that way. Access to more of the house as well as a rooftop bar and photo op.
author: Malia_B

title: Architectural Delight!
text: I booked the Platinum ticket so I could see everything. SO WORTH IT! Go early to beat the crowds. This masterpiece is just astounding. I loved going alone so I could just soak it all in at my own pace. The iPad provided was great to have for the added experience. Highly recommend! I spent about four hours there.
author: kathyblackdennis
